game_concept: A strategy race set in Eldritch Ruins – Cracked Obelisk, a cracked obelisk: the rune scholar must handle crypt crawlers while practicing lists. Core idea – Slice Slicer: Cut lists with slices like items[1:4] to grab exactly the right group.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Cracked Obelisk: a cracked obelisk
core_gameplay_loop: In Cracked Obelisk, repeat each round: Cut lists with slices like items[1:4] to grab exactly the right group. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the rune scholar ahead. Then check the slice_ok value and advance.
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the sealed archway by solving code steps involving slice_ok that move the rune scholar forward.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.95).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the sealed archway first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 7 (applied tier): Slice Slicer
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Slice Slicer' (Week 7 slot 3), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Cracked Obelisk'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Eldritch Ruins
region.mood: eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how slice_ok changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against crypt crawlers in Cracked Obelisk.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.95).
